notes.title: 👻 Five Nights: No Escape Update & Call for Brave Testers 💥
notes.notes:
Greetings, Survivors! 🙋‍♀️🙋‍♂️ We've got some hair-raising news to share about "Five Nights: No Escape." 
🚫 Bug Busting 🚫

Fixed server error reporting issue

Solve ghost room

Multiplayer mode bugs fix

Phew, you can finally sleep a little easier! 😌 But don't rest too comfortably, for a new terror awaits...
📢 Call for Testers of our new horror game! 📢 We're summoning all courageous souls wielding  Quest headset to join us in crafting our newest nightmare - "Horror: Evil Residents." This upcoming VR horror experience needs your screams...err, feedback to truly terrify!

What's the game about?
Horror: Evil Residents is a multiplayer horror game that supports up to 4 players. In a terrifying atmosphere, players must complete each set of tasks and find traces that can identify the ghosts. Players need to work together, using various tools and clues, while avoiding dangerous ghosts to ensure their survival. This game not only tests players' teamwork skills but also provides a thrilling and intense horror experience.

🔗 To Join the Scare Squad 🔗
Click > https://www.meta.com/s/1qoDsxZjM
And join our Discord for more info and find matches! https://discord.gg/K6eRsxf9dR

ps. this test now only open for Quest Players, we will try to get it on Steam in the future~

Don't keep us waiting, brave ones! Let's make this the most petrifying VR experience ever created! 👻🩸🔪

notes.title: New Version Update: Mask On, Adventure Awaits!
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

We're thrilled to announce a fresh update to Five Nights: No Escape that's sure to enhance your gaming adventure!

In the updated we have focused on Easy Mask Attachment. There's no need to hold your mask for the entire time for it to stay on your face anymore. Bring the mask close to your head, and it will automatically attach. Grab the mask again, and it comes off effortlessly.

We've also fixed some bugs to make your gaming experience more smooth and enjoyable.

Thank you for your continuous support and enthusiasm. We can't wait to see how these changes improve your gaming experience. As always, we're eager to hear your feedback and make the game the best it can be.
